notes.title: Air Brawl 1.01 patch notes
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/m2forMy.png[/img] 

Text: 

TDM win count decreased to 25

FFA win count decreased to 15

Flag pickup guitar riff volume decreased by 50%

Fixes:

Fixed bug where long server names would cover the server map name.

Fixed bug where game would crash when quitting.

Removed white cube from park. The cube was used to show the scale of a human and was left in the game by mistake.

Fixed bug where playing a game and then playing the tutorial would display the online escape menu in the tutorial.

Fixed bug where blinding light would only blind a part of the vikings vision.

Maybe fixed bug where the "Meet your maker" and "Slayer of gods" achievements would not be rewarded when killing/getting killed by devs.

Fixed bug where info texts when joining a server would block each other

notes.title: Air Brawl
notes.content:
[img] http://i.imgur.com/cVbPSNb.png [/img]  
  
In text:
Music. the game is getting a soundtrack written by Stephen Hicks. Including main menu music, in game music and short stingers for winning a game, losing a game, stealing a flag ect.

Full menu remake. All menus have been remade from scratch.
Lots of UI improvements. We've worked a lot on freshening up the games interface.

Player levels and stats. There will be a tab in the main menu where you can keep track of how many kills, captures, crashes you have achieved so far. You will also have a player level which is increase by getting kills and playing the objective. Your level will be displayed next to your name on the scoreboard.

better bots. The current ones are not very interesting to fight against. The new bots are not as predictable and provide more of a challenge.

New weapon: Leaf burst. A 3 shot burst weapon for The Elder.

New weapon: Unholy smite. A new primary weapons for the Witch doctor which fires lasers that deal high damage after a slight delay

New tutorial map. The tutorial has gotten a new map as well as some other graphical improvements

Info when joining a server. The game now gives you some info when joining a server. Such as "Creating new room" and "Joining existing room"

A new death cam that shows who killed you.

A menu page for the games control scheme.

Obstacle course loss condition. Obstacle race now ends after 5 minutes if no one manages to beat the map.

More useful cockpits. The cockpits have been tuned to give the player a wider field of view.

A free look cam. You can now hold down middle mouse button to activate the free look cam.

Lots of balancing and bug fixes.

The options menu is now reachable when playing.

notes.title: Air Brawl 0.1.9.3 released!
notes.content:
Features:

Mjölnir
A new primary weapon for the viking.

Holy shields
A new secondary for the cyber priest.

Exit button on map vote screen

Map/game mode button displays selected map/game mode

New text that displays information when joining a server.

Added a tunnel through the park.

Performance improvements on park and stronghold.
